description.value: This McDonald's sits on the second floor (level 1) of a building on the busy Broadway-Cambie corridor in Vancouver, without a drive-through. It offers both indoor and outdoor seating alongside takeaway and delivery options, making it a quick resupply stop for cyclists travelling along the Broadway corridor. The location is a standard urban franchise outlet with no cycling-specific features confirmed.
